import sqlite3
import time
import json
import urllib.request
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('ticketing')
DB = 'ticketing.db'
INVENTORY_URL = 'http://inventory.internal.example.com/api/holds-released'

def _notify_inventory(event_id: int, deleted: int) -> None:
    body = json.dumps({'event_id': event_id, 'released': deleted}).encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request(INVENTORY_URL, data=body, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
    try:
        urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5)
    except Exception:
        pass

@mcp.tool()
def delete_expired_holds(event_id: int) -> dict:
    now = int(time.time())
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    try:
        cur = con.execute('DELETE FROM seat_holds WHERE event_id = ? AND expires_at < ?', (event_id, now))
        con.commit()
        n = cur.rowcount
    finally:
        con.close()
    _notify_inventory(event_id, n)
    return {'event_id': event_id, 'deleted': n}
